======================================================

regression locks for Phase 4 (annotations subsystem cycle).

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RED BASELINE (pre-Phase-4-test-introduction)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

The 9 P0 contracts I wrote tests for are ALL satisfied by the current
production code. There is no RED baseline to capture in the
traditional sense — the existing src/annotations/* and src/ui/* code
already meets the contracts described in UI-AN-01, 03, 06, 10, 12,
13, 14, 18, 33.

This is consistent with the Phase 3 outcome for UI-TE-SEL-01 and
UI-TE-UNDO-01, where the audit's hypothetical bug pattern was already
fixed by prior commits (Tm-sign canonical-matrix work, per-font extent
scaling, etc.). The Phase 4 audit rows are gap-coverage rather than
documented bug reports — the existing test_annotation_*.cpp suite
covered placement and basic create paths but didn't lock the
undo/save/signal-flow invariants.

The 9 new tests serve as REGRESSION LOCKS rather than bug fixes:
each invariant is now red-on-regression, so any future change to
the annotation pipeline that breaks one of these contracts (e.g. a
refactor of MainWindow's tool callback wiring, or a change to
AnnotationManager that drops /A dict serialization) will be caught
in CI immediately.

Coverage notes
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

UI-AN-02 (StickyNote popup-on-click pixel assertion):
  Deferred to Phase 9 / D1 -- requires real Qt event dispatch through
  PdfCanvas. Smoke covered by tests/test_ui_annotations_smoke.py.

UI-AN-22 (annotation toolbar setIcon): Audit-flagged as missing.
  Smoke captures a baseline screenshot for D1's visual-regression
  diff. The setIcon fix is consolidated with the broader visual-
  fidelity / icon-glyph work (Phase 9).

P1 rows (UI-AN-04, 05, 07, 09, 11, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23, 24, 29, 30,
34, 35): 15 P1 rows in the audit. Phase 4 covers indirectly via the
P0 wiring tests (resize/delete/markup quads paths) plus the existing
test_annotation_*.cpp suite. Direct coverage of the remaining specific
P1 invariants (italic/underline-quad alignment, stamp tokens UI
integration, alt-text dialog, color round-trip across reopen) is
deferred to Phase D1 with the consolidated test_annotation_*.cpp
expansion. Deferral rate ~80% — comparable to Phase 3, structurally
driven by the audit's per-row file decomposition that pushes most
families to D1.


Production source changed in Phase 4: NONE.
  No edits to src/annotations/* or src/ui/* were required. The
  contracts hold against current production code; the value of this
  cycle is the regression locks plus the harness layer.

Suite delta: +9 active C++ tests, +3 active Python tests, 0 failures.
